title: Contact Us
html:
Get IT help whenever wherever you need

Our IT support services are decentralized, with each faculty having a dedicated IT support team. These local IT groups are your go-to for classroom and general support. Please contact your faculty IT support for the quickest and most effective assistance. If your faculty doesn't have its own IT support, or UIT handles your faculty's IT needs, contact us directly using the details below. We're here to help!
